entries.text: Metadata Primitives and Data Vault now run on SQLite. Every Metadata Primitives query has a SQLite form built on sqlite_master and the pragma table functions instead of the missing information_schema, Data Vault query 1 uses the standard INTERVAL form so its date arithmetic translates, and Data Vault tables get hash-key indexes so the suite finishes in about a minute at scale 0.1 instead of exceeding 25 minutes.
